name: Update Recurring Event Instance
description: Update an individual instance of a recurring event in the user's default calendar. [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/event-update?view=graph-rest-1.0&tabs=http)

configurable_props.name: recurringEventId
configurable_props.label: Recurring Event ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the recurring event series

configurable_props.name: startDateTime
configurable_props.label: Start Date Time
configurable_props.description: The start of the time range to find instances, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., `2024-01-01T00:00:00Z`)

configurable_props.name: endDateTime
configurable_props.label: End Date Time
configurable_props.description: The end of the time range to find instances, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., `2024-12-31T23:59:59Z`)

configurable_props.name: instanceId
configurable_props.label: Instance ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the specific occurrence of the recurring event

configurable_props.name: timeZone
configurable_props.label: Time Zone
configurable_props.description: Time zone of the event in supported time zones, [See the docs](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/outlookuser-supportedtimezones)

configurable_props.name: start
configurable_props.label: Start
configurable_props.description: New start date-time for this instance (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss). Requires **Time Zone** to be set.

configurable_props.name: end
configurable_props.label: End
configurable_props.description: New end date-time for this instance (yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss). Requires **Time Zone** to be set.

configurable_props.name: isOnlineMeeting
configurable_props.label: Is Online Meeting
configurable_props.description: If it is online meeting or not
